name: The Legendary Alliance
caption: A trio who beat Vanity Flare in the main event of the fed's only surviving card, the brawl spilling across the casino's own dancer stage.

name: Vanity Flare

tenures.note: The commentators open Torture Chamber 2 by calling "Fantasy" Kevin Legend and "Vegas Vengeance" Victor Vance two members of Vanity Flare; Vance comes to the ring with his valet Veronica Vance, and the pair double-team Jim Mongol in the elimination tag match. The page names the pairing: "You've got 2 members of the Vanity Flare tagging up against two men who were basically put together out of necessity".

caption: A trio, valeted by Lovely Leslie Luv and Veronica Vance, beaten by the Legendary Alliance in the main event of the fed's only surviving card.

name: Knights of the Squared Circle
